newsitem.title: USA: Gilbert backs 1997 operating EPS views.
newsitem.headline: Gilbert backs 1997 operating EPS views.

text.p: Gilbert Associated Inc said Wednesday it remains comfortable with full year 1997 earnings per share estimates of $0.85 to $0.90 from continuing operations.
The estimate comes before the effect of a $6,150,000 write-off of in process research and development associated with the acquisition of TEC Cellular in the second quarter.
Before the effect of that write off, the company said it believes it is capable of generating net income of $300,000 to $600,000 and earnings per share of $0.05 to $0.10.
This would compare to a loss of $49,000, or $0.01 per share from continuing operations in the second quarter of 1996, the company said.
